title: Run Fable 5 + GPT-5.6 Together Inside Claude Code
description:
What if your AI could plan, execute, review, and improve its own work?

In this video, I show you how to combine Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 inside Claude Code to create a multi-agent workflow that handles software development more efficiently.

Here's what you'll learn:

How to install Codex
Set up the Codex plugin inside Claude Code
Connect Fable 5 and GPT-5.6
Use Fable as the orchestrator
Let GPT-5.6 execute coding tasks
Review and refine outputs automatically
Build a multi-agent AI workflow for software development

Instead of relying on a single model, this setup lets specialized AI roles collaborate on the same project.
